name: Can I prevent tree roots from entering my sewer line?

mainEntity.name: Can I prevent tree roots from entering my sewer line?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing root intrusion involves several strategies. Consider planting slow-growing trees or shrubs away from your sewer lines. Root barriers can be installed around pipes. Regular professional inspections and preventative maintenance, such as annual hydro-jetting, can help keep roots from establishing themselves or remove them before they cause significant blockages.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent roots by planting trees away from lines, installing root barriers, and performing regular professional inspections or hydro-jetting.
